description: any_to_str_bytes (lines 573-588) returns None for unhandled string types (TeletexString, BMPString), causing ava_values_match (lines 560-570) to fall back to raw DER byte comparison. This is the correct fail-closed default: if the implementation doesn't understand an encoding, don't guess at normalization—require exact binary match instead. This prevents subtle bugs where unsafe normalization of T61/BMP could incorrectly match or reject semantically equivalent names. Explicitly tracked as v0.1 limitation with forward reference to RFC 5280 §7.1 for v0.2 legacy encoding support.
title: Decision: Fail-closed on unrecognized DirectoryString types
